anchor: Latest earlier genuine completed MARK observation both available and installed at or before the missing minute completion evaluation clock
clock_contract: Explicit source minute OPEN; raw inclusive CLOSE is OPEN+59999ms; completed boundary is OPEN+60000ms; actual mapping is separately pinned metadata and never inferred from an ambiguous timestamp
consecutive_holes: Every estimate keeps the original genuine anchor identity; estimates never enter the observation set
freshness: Retain original genuine anchor availability and installation times; no synthetic fresh source availability or recovery
price_representation: Copy exact input decimal string; no conversion, rounding, epsilon, fitting or interpolation

sensitivity_reference_range.financial_arithmetic: None; quantity/cashflow sensitivity PENDING actual saved event evidence
sensitivity_reference_range.interpretation: Weak descriptive past-price anchors only; not a future bound, robust stress guarantee, probability statement, or financial safety evidence
